sections.section: ORDER - Martial Law Order By Chief Martial Law Administrator No. 95
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
MARTIAL LAW ORDER BY CHIEF MARTIAL LAW
ADMINISTRATOR No. 95
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th January, 1984]
In Martial Law Order No. 5, in
paragraph 1, for clause `e', the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"e.
Whipping not more than 30 stripes in public or in jail as directed by the court
which shall be executed as provided for in Execution of the Punish ment of
Whipping Ordinance, 1979 (IX o f 1979) :-
Provided that punishment of
whipping shall not be awarded by a Military Court to women of any age or men
over 45 years or persons below the age of 18 years, or those declared infirm by
a competent medical board.".
